What this is

Three things worth knowing before you write to me.

Grounded

No cards, no charts, no spirits. I read your story the way a sharp friend with a psychology habit would — for pattern, blind spot, and what's really driving it.

Written

You get something you can re-read. A considered reply, not a call. Usually 600–900 words, sent to your inbox.

Honest

I won't tell you what's comfortable. If the story points somewhere you don't want to look, I'll still say it — kindly, but straight.

Process

The descent.

The Drop

You let it go

Write down whatever's stuck — a relationship, a decision, a pattern that keeps repeating. No format required. The more honest, the more useful the reply.

The Dive

I go down into it

Not skimmed. I sit with what you've sent, notice what's underneath the surface story, and work out what actually needs saying.

The Surface

You come back up with it

Within 48 hours, in writing. Something clear enough to act on, and honest enough to sit with.

Immediate support

Need help right now?

This site is not monitored in real time. If you are unsafe, injured, or in a crisis, please use one of these free, confidential options instead of waiting to submit a message.

No one is reading messages here in real time. If it is an emergency, call local emergency services first.

112 — Emergency Services

Police, ambulance or fire response across the EU and many other places

Call

988 — Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (US)

National support for anyone in emotional distress or suicidal crisis

Call

13 11 14 — Lifeline (Australia)

24/7 crisis support and suicide prevention

Call
